blocking_findings.finding: All 178 cases have false governing-clause mappings and substantively import discarded f0 case/expectation authority.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Reconstruct normative cases directly from exact R6, imported rejection, and both R7 report bytes. Remove f0 as normative/executable authority unless a separate governing action expressly authorizes and graph-binds it.

blocking_findings.finding: Expectations, event actuals and observations are not independent; expected values enter actual-event construction and material obligations are never evaluated.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Author expectations independently before execution; deny them to event/observation producers; derive status/effects from raw current evidence; enforce every required/forbidden evidence, side-effect, durability, replay and restart rule.

blocking_findings.finding: The 178-case suite invokes only trusted-child execute_case fixture/meta handlers and contains zero outer terminal/reconciliation public-interface cases.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Use actual hostile caller classes and public submit/execute/retrieve/verify/reconcile/ledger/trust surfaces, including all direct R7 replay/fabrication/append/downgrade regressions.

blocking_findings.finding: The service shallowly trusts child outcome/inner identity claims; comparator and terminal verification cannot distinguish a semantically false but internally consistent graph.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Make the terminal service independently resolve raw process/request/response/receipt/ledger/side-effect evidence and independently derive semantics; use a comparator with a distinct oracle and no shared actual-generation logic.

blocking_findings.finding: Launcher, Python subject, worker, comparator and fixture inherit the service SID, which can use the signing key and modify terminal stores.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Run every subordinate under a genuinely distinct restricted principal/token/job with no key use, authority IPC, ledger/checkpoint/receipt/reconciliation/trust/policy write, or SeImpersonate capability; broker only narrow session I/O.

blocking_findings.finding: The IPC parser accepts duplicate keys and numeric string coercion and does not bind complete framed canonical/schema bytes; duplicate operation bypass was reproduced live.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Implement length-delimited complete framing, pre-parse duplicate-key detection, strict UTF-8/NFC/types, canonical roundtrip, exact schemas and semantic validation at every level; reject trailing/multiple objects.

blocking_findings.finding: The v3/DRAFT service/policy/interface upgrade is self-authorized with the preserved v1 key; 11 upgrade content addresses are unresolved and no anti-downgrade lifecycle exists.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Create a separately governed, pre-install signed, durable, publicly resolvable upgrade transition binding old/new service, policy, interface, IPC, worker, dependencies, key and ledger with activation, revocation and anti-rollback rules.

blocking_findings.finding: The current public verifier cannot verify all retained receipts across upgrade history; verify-all and the oldest terminal receipt fail fixed-authority checks.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Provide a governed version-aware public trust/verifier chain that validates every retained receipt and upgrade transition without private authority or mutable implementation state.

blocking_findings.finding: Authority append precedes durable response storage; seq 678 proves a client-visible rejection can leave a reusable signed attempt. Ten post-correction top-level authorities lack responses.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Use recoverable transactional request states and reconstructable idempotent responses; define pending/committed/aborted/superseded states and never report rejection while leaving usable issued authority.

blocking_findings.finding: A crash after durable entry append but before checkpoint replacement causes restart rejection with no forward recovery.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Adopt a WAL/atomic checkpoint protocol or deterministic signed-chain forward recovery, prove directory durability, and test every crash window.

blocking_findings.finding: Path-based reads do not reject reparse/hardlink/ADS/8.3/rename/read-after-hash substitution or hold immutable final-path handles.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Use no-follow handle opens, final NT-path/file-ID/link/stream checks and held handles across governed use; separate mutable child roots from authority roots.

blocking_findings.finding: Git, framework references and per-use Python dependencies are not completely content-bound; Python user-site is reopened.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Content-address every executable/reference/config/import dependency at each governed use or retain verified immutable handles; close import/DLL/current-directory/search paths and remove user-site.

blocking_findings.finding: Incomplete seq-332 has no governed abort/cancel/supersession and retains a junction/fixture evidence; permanent nonreuse is unproved.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Add public durable incomplete-issuance recovery/abort/supersession semantics while preserving historical evidence.

blocking_findings.finding: All 1,424 trace rows start from false normative roots and omit complete semantic, host, dependency, upgrade and recovery reverse mappings.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Rebuild bidirectional trace from exact clause bytes through actual raw execution and every host artifact; reject circular/self-authored summary mappings.

blocking_findings.finding: Complete binary input closure is absent: normalized IL matches six roles but framework references are unmeasured and the seventh installed role is unavailable.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Bind compiler, all source, reference assemblies, options, architecture and runtime inputs; produce reproducible or fully explained PE identities for every installed role.

blocking_findings.finding: No new independently authorized eight-run/four-reconciliation matrix or service-stopped verification was produced in this review.
blocking_findings.required_correction: After remediation and fresh authorization, run a new independent matrix and service-stopped public-verification audit; do not reuse authored evidence.
